parameters.query:
insert into public.quotes (contact_id, product_id, inputs, status)
select c.id, p.id, $3::jsonb, 'draft'
from public.contacts c, public.products p
where c.phone = regexp_replace($1, '\D', '', 'g') and p.code = $2
returning id;

select i.id as insurer_id, i.code as insurer_code, i.api_enabled, i.api_base_url, i.api_auth_type,
       coalesce(rr.commission_pct, i.commission_default_pct) as commission_pct,
       rr.base_premium, rr.coverage_sum, rr.deductible, rr.coverage_items, rt.source
from public.insurers i
left join public.rate_tables rt
       on rt.insurer_id = i.id and rt.is_active
      and rt.product_id = (select id from public.products where code = $1)
      and current_date between rt.valid_from and coalesce(rt.valid_to,'9999-12-31')
left join lateral (
  select * from public.rate_rows r
   where r.rate_table_id = rt.id
     and (r.criteria->>'age_min' is null or (($2::jsonb->>'edad')::int) >= (r.criteria->>'age_min')::int)
     and (r.criteria->>'age_max' is null or (($2::jsonb->>'edad')::int) <= (r.criteria->>'age_max')::int)
     and (r.criteria->>'cc_max'  is null or (($2::jsonb->>'cc')::int)   <= (r.criteria->>'cc_max')::int)
     and (r.criteria->>'cc_min'  is null or (($2::jsonb->>'cc')::int)   >= (r.criteria->>'cc_min')::int)
   order by r.priority limit 1
) rr on true
where i.status = 'active';

parameters.query:
insert into public.quote_lines
  (quote_id, insurer_id, source, premium, coverage_sum, deductible, coverage_items,
   commission_pct, commission_amount, rank, unavailable_reason)
values ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3, $4::numeric, $5::numeric, $6::numeric,
        coalesce($7::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), $8::numeric, $9::numeric, $10::int, $11)

nodes.name: Insertar quote_lines
nodes.notes: executeQuery en vez de operation:insert — el resourceMapper del nodo pedía columns.mappingMode y la config traía un string plano, que rompía la ejecución.

parameters.query:
with agg as (
  select count(*) filter (where premium is not null) as disponibles,
         count(*) as total,
         (select id from public.quote_lines where quote_id = $1 and premium is not null order by rank asc limit 1) as best_id,
         array_agg(insurer_id) filter (where premium is null) as faltantes
  from public.quote_lines where quote_id = $1
)
update public.quotes q
set status = case
              when agg.disponibles = agg.total then 'completed'
              when agg.disponibles = 0 then 'manual_pending'
              else 'partial'
            end,
    best_line_id = agg.best_id,
    missing_insurers = coalesce((select array_agg(code) from public.insurers where id = any(agg.faltantes)), '{}')
from agg
where q.id = $1
returning q.id, q.status, q.missing_insurers, q.best_line_id;
